text.offer: Caramo reads from a warrant. "By order of the Office: the orc shamans in the caves beyond Tos have cursed a magistrate's well. Four of them are to be brought to justice, which in their case means the end of a blade." She adds, "Their chambers are deep in the orc caves and Ugol's Warren. They throw fire."
text.progress: The orc shamans keep to the depths of the orc caves beyond Tos and the enigmatic chamber of Ugol's Warren.
text.complete: "Four shamans. The well is already clearing, they say." Caramo stamps the warrant. "The Office will have another for you tomorrow."
